helpPlay: p <h>                    play hand card h onto the pile
helpLog: log | l                  show the action log
helpSetPlayers: sp [2-4]                 set the number of players
captureLegend: * = captures the pile (matches the top card, or a jack sweeps it)
promptHelp: p <hand> to play a card (capture the pile by matching rank or with a Jack)
provisionalNote: Provisional totals count only pisti bonuses and most-cards (+3); card points are added at scoring
